protocol: Retain every initial annotation/reference. First run original v08 structural and exact-span validators with explicit v09 manifests/question plan. Source-only semantic review may select at most one revised artifact per initial output; retain reasons and hashes. Failure after one revision remains excluded, never silently repaired.
reviewer_provenance: Unversioned conversational model roles, shared training possible; not independent human adjudication.
scope: No event date from document/delivery dates unless explicit relative timing
Succession or new plan is not explicit correction
All semantic claims and spans grounded in the exact request
scorer_access: No scores used for annotation or reference review.
